name: Samesuga Shin'ichi
source:
Is mentor of Jirou who is an infamous playboy. Jirou who takes Samesuga teaching to heart and credits for his success ironically the same knowledge does not work for Samesuga who is still very unsuccessful with women. 

Works at post office since growing up and has become semi ok musician selling cds on side.
